scripts.dev: start npm run dev:auth & start npm run dev:home & start npm run dev:device & start npm run dev:gateway
scripts.test:setup:auth: dotenv -e apps/auth-service/.env.test -- npx prisma migrate reset --force --skip-generate --schema=apps/auth-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test:setup:home: dotenv -e apps/home-service/.env.test -- npx prisma migrate reset --force --skip-generate --schema=apps/home-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test:setup:device: dotenv -e apps/device-service/.env.test -- npx prisma migrate reset --force --skip-generate --schema=apps/device-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test:setup: npm run test:setup:auth && npm run test:setup:home && npm run test:setup:device
scripts.test:auth: dotenv -e apps/auth-service/.env.test -- cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest apps/auth-service
scripts.test:home: dotenv -e apps/home-service/.env.test -- cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest apps/home-service
scripts.test:device: dotenv -e apps/device-service/.env.test -- cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest apps/device-service
scripts.test: npm run test:setup && npm run test:auth && npm run test:home && npm run test:device
